description: Score every component's complexity (1-10) from ITS OWN declaration span — lines, JSX depth, props, and hooks are counted per component, so co-located components in one file each get their own accurate score. Use threshold 5+ for moderate issues, 7+ for refactoring candidates. Scope: rootPath scanned to depth 5, node_modules excluded; unparseable files are reported in warnings rather than silently dropped.

rootPath.description: Path to scan for React components

name: get_complexity_report
